checks: same reference, accepted alternatives, target, structures, split, tier and family as the original (molbench.tasks.check_corpus)
the reference grades as exactly right against the paraphrase (runner.grade_parsed)
every slot value of the original appears in the wording (nothing needed is dropped)
its twin on the other track has the same words and the same style
provenance.original_prompt: Load 2CPP. Show the protein as a cartoon and the two ligands as ball-and-stick, one yellow and the other purple.

checks: each of the 2 accepted states: the atoms it draws, read back from pdbe_state.replay, equal the atoms computed from the atom-table columns
reference grades as exactly right against the task (success, F1 1, target score 1; runner.grade_parsed)
every accepted alternative grades as itself, is accepted by the task with target score 1, and is a different final state from the reference
target selects 54 atoms on the frozen atom table
no accepted state equals another (pairwise, by the grader)
twin selects the same target atoms
source.rule: The entry has exactly two different ligands, one copy each; the request gives two colours, "one ... and the other ...". Accepted: both assignments.
not_accepted: both ligands the same colour, or only one ligand shown: the request asks for both, in different colours
ions, water or bonded protein residues shown as ligands: not ligands of the entry

notes: Left open: which ligand gets which colour. Reference = accepted state 1 of 2 (CAM yellow, HEM purple); the others are in 'accepted', in the order of provenance.accepted_states.
